backlogged.summary: The SPEC §8.11 metrics text says `queue_ms` is non-null only for `verify` and `post_merge_verify` lines. The `pre_merge_verify` line was added to the step list with its own note that it matches `verify`, but the general `queue_ms` and `cached` sentences were not updated. The text is slightly inconsistent.

preMergeVerify leaves untracked files that the verify wrote in the feature worktree, because `git checkout -f` only resets tracked files. Such files could leak into the later lock merge or into the eval diff. The tests do not cover this.
The existing tests f25 and f32 were adjusted to filter out pre-merge-verify calls. This is reasonable, but those filters are tied to string matching on the merge commit message `(pre-merge verify)`.
